title: Develop the master blueprint, PRD, architecture and phased execution plan before any code is written
Obtain the owner's decisions on ADR-03, ADR-14, ADR-17 and ADR-18 before the first migration
description: Owner decides, from the S1-T1 check results: job mechanism form (ADR-03), append-only database trigger (ADR-14, fixes TEST-S1-21's form), runtime versions (ADR-17) and the custom user model (ADR-18). Recorded as ADR status changes in 003 in a docs PR. Blocks the project skeleton and every migration.

title: Plan legacy data compatibility so no live first-generation record is discarded
description: Separate explicit plan for live first-generation records: inventory by sanitized evidence packets through catalyst-legacy-analyst, mapping, coexistence and cutover rules. Blocks cutover; does not block the first slice.

title: Prepare staging, deployment, backup with demonstrated restore, monitoring and the reversible Learn routing cutover
description: Phase P6. Separate deployment authorization required. Includes staff host, MFA, retention enforcement, restore drill and cutover rehearsal against the verified route baseline in 003.

title: Provision the approved mailbox, activate the applicant, and support withdrawal and recovery
description: Phase P5 (journey J-14 to J-16). Coarse until provisioning scope (POL-11) and withdrawal rules (POL-12) are decided and MXroute provisioning capability is verified.

title: Issue and verify the NDA, User Agreement and other required agreements through Documenso with protected custody
description: Phase P4 (journey J-11 to J-13). Coarse until the agreement inventory (POL-07), signing roles (POL-08) and custody (POL-09) are decided. Non-production Documenso only.

title: Collect evidence, run the bounded MiniMax assessment, and record the authorized qualification decision
description: Phase P3 (journey J-04 to J-06 and J-10). Coarse until evidence (POL-03), rubric (POL-04) and qualification authority (POL-05) are decided. Model calls use PydanticAI test models in CI.

title: Run the applicant correspondence loop: outbound policy, inbox correlation, reminders, stop rules and human takeover
description: Phase P2 (011 work graph; journey stages J-07 to J-09 in 004). Coarse until the communications policy (POL-06) is decided. Tested against a local mail and IMAP test server only.

title: Prove the first slice against its acceptance plan and record the evidence
description: Run the full acceptance plan in 005 S1.7 (TEST-S1-01 to TEST-S1-21) on PostgreSQL in CI, record PASS, FAIL, SKIPPED, NOT RUN separately with run links, independent QA review, and the epic after-action report (009 section 10).

title: Give authorized staff a read-only view of applications and their history, and refuse everyone else
description: Django admin with view-only permissions for a read-only staff group: application list, detail, submission versions, history and pending actions. Anonymous and unauthorized users are refused. Acceptance: TEST-S1-11, TEST-S1-12.

title: Confirm contact control once through an explicit, expiring, single-use confirmation
description: GET shows a confirmation page with no state change; POST with a valid, unexpired, unused challenge records verified contact control once and queues the next-stage placeholder action at most once. Acceptance: TEST-S1-08 to TEST-S1-10.

title: Run the durable worker that sends the verification message to the local mail sink and recovers after interruption
description: Worker follows the ledger rules in 005 S1.4: claim with SKIP LOCKED and a lease token, attempts counted at claim, poison rule, fenced result write, database clock, paused and held actions never claimed. Sends to the local mail sink only. Acceptance: TEST-S1-06, TEST-S1-07, TEST-S1-17 to TEST-S1-19.

title: Accept the public access-request form with validation, duplicate handling and one atomic commit
description: Public form, server-side validation, normalized email, duplicate and concurrent-retry handling, and one transaction committing application, submission version, history event and the verification pending action. Acceptance: TEST-S1-01 to TEST-S1-05.

title: Model the application, submission versions, history events and pending actions with their constraints
description: Minimal models for the slice only (005 S1.4): custom user, Application, SubmissionVersion, ApplicationEvent, ContactChallenge, subject-generic PendingAction and AutomationPause (no foreign key from workflow to any domain model), OutboundMessage, with the constraints listed there. Migrations reviewed by catalyst-django-data. Acceptance: TEST-S1-15, TEST-S1-20.

title: Create the Django project skeleton with PostgreSQL-only settings, provider guards and the CI runtime lane
description: Project package, environment-driven settings that refuse to start without PostgreSQL and refuse real SMTP or provider hosts outside production, the runtime-code CI lane with a PostgreSQL service, and the check-docs script (009 P4). Acceptance: TEST-S1-13, TEST-S1-14.

title: Select and verify the Django, Python, PostgreSQL, driver and job-runner versions for the first slice
description: Run the compatibility checks in 005 S1.6 and record the results in ADR-17; prepare the owner's decisions on ADR-03 (job mechanism form), ADR-14 (append-only database trigger) and ADR-18 (custom user model). All must be decided before the first migration. No install outside the task branch's own environment.

title: Build the first working slice: synthetic intake, email verification to a local mail sink, and a read-only staff view
description: Phase P1 of the build contract (005 section S1). Synthetic applicant form, validation and duplicate handling, one atomic commit of application, submission version, history and pending action, a durable worker that sends verification to a local mail sink, single-use explicit confirmation, and a read-only staff view. No real email, MiniMax, Documenso, provisioning or Twenty writes. Local and CI only; no deployment.

title: Obtain owner decisions on the open product policies listed in the master blueprint
description: Track the open policy register (POL-01 to POL-19 in 011 section 6): duplicate policy, verification lifetime, evidence and form fields, rubric, qualification authority, communications, agreements, signing roles, custody, retention, provisioning scope, withdrawal, staff roles and MFA, staff host, legacy data, operating targets, applicant notices, required details, identity disputes. Each entry names the earliest milestone it blocks. No policy text that cannot be public goes in this bead.

title: Obtain the owner's approval of the build contract and the first-slice scope
description: Owner reviews the draft build-contract PR (master blueprint 011, PRD 002, architecture 003, journey 004, first-slice spec 005) and approves, amends or rejects the first-slice scope. Approval of the documents is not approval to deploy. Blocks the first-slice epic.
